claims.text: The proposed model outperforms the R.M.-Reader + Verifier model by 0.7 in terms of F1 score.
The model is compared to many existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The proposed model achieves competitive results to the state-of-the-art on SQuAD 2.0 without relying on large pre-trained language models.
